title: Automatic Knowledge Graph Construction and Query for Earthquake Catalogs
abstract: arXiv:2607.24984v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In recent years, the number of events in earthquake catalogs has significantly increased due to the utilization of more effective deep learning based detectors and phase pickers but answering open ended questions such as what characterizes this sequence? remains constrained by rigid spatiotemporal windowing and subjective expert interpretation. We present the first systematic application of graph based retrieval augmented generation GraphRAG directly to raw, tabular catalog records across three independently featured catalogs, a reservoir adjacent swarm, the 2019 Ridgecrest tectonic sequence, and the 2021 Maduo Mw7.4 aftershock sequence. Without the need for manual data structuring, the pipeline builds structurally complete, queryable knowledge graphs for all three. Rigorous evaluation individually verified against catalog derived ground truth and a rule based reference graph exposes failure modes, and four seismology informed

translated_title: 地震目录的自动知识图谱构建与查询
translated_abstract: 近年来，由于采用了更有效的基于深度学习的地震检测器和震相拾取器，地震目录中的事件数量显著增加，但回答诸如“这次地震序列的特征是什么？”之类的开放式问题仍然受限于僵化的时空窗口划分和主观的专家解释。我们首次系统性地将基于图的检索增强生成直接应用于原始的表格化目录记录，涵盖三个具有不同特征的目录：水库附近的震群、2019年Ridgecrest构造地震序列，以及2021年玛多Mw7.4余震序列。无需人工数据结构化，该流程为所有三个目录构建了结构完整、可查询的知识图谱。严格的评估——分别针对基于目录导出的真值和基于规则的参考图谱进行逐一验证——揭示了失败模式，以及四个基于地震学知识的（内容因摘要截断而未完整显示）……
tldr: 本文首次系统性地将GraphRAG（基于图的检索增强生成）直接应用于原始表格化地震目录记录，无需人工数据结构化即可自动构建可查询的知识图谱，并在水库震群、Ridgecrest构造序列和玛多余震序列三个真实目录上通过严格评估验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic application of GraphRAG directly to raw tabular earthquake catalog records, automatically constructing structurally complete and queryable knowledge graphs without manual data structuring, validated through rigorous evaluation across three independently featured catalogs.
